headline: Brentford upset Chelsea in historic win at home

headline: Xabi Alonso joins unwanted managerial group after heavy Brentford defeat
description: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso joined an unenvied group of managers on Friday night as his side continued their poor defensive start to the Premier League campaign with a 3-0 defeat at Brentford.
